source_refs.note: Book p. 171-172: 9.1.1 Remainder Theorem, statement and proof (i), Examples 3-4. Book errors: proof line f(x) = (a - a)q(a) + R; 'Remember' for Remainder in Example 4. Teaching notes, Key points, Common mistakes are ours.

blocks.text: Pichle page (9.1) par Example 1 mein ek dilchasp baat nazar aayi thi: \(x - 2\) se divide karne par jo remainder aaya, wohi number dividend mein \(x = 2\) rakhne se bhi aaya. Aaj hum saabit karenge ke yeh ittefaq nahin balke ek qaida (theorem) hai: remainder theorem. Is ka faida yeh hai ke agar sirf remainder chahiye to lambi division ki zaroorat hi nahin; ek substitution (value rakhna) kaafi hai. Exam mein yeh waqt bachane wala sab se bara shortcut hai.
Kitab ki statement: agar degree \(n \ge 1\) wale polynomial \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se itna divide karein ke remainder mein koi \(x\) wali term na bache, to remainder \(f(a)\) hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is statement ke teen hisson ko khol kar samajhte hain:
1. "Remainder mein koi \(x\)-term na bache" ka matlab hai ke hum tab tak divide karte hain jab tak remainder sirf ek number (constant) na reh jaye. Divisor ki degree 1 hai, is liye remainder ki degree hamesha 0 hogi.
2. \(a\) ko divisor se dhyan se parhna hai: \(x - 3\) mein \(a = 3\); lekin \(x + 1 = x - (-1)\) mein \(a = -1\). Yani \(x + a\) se divide karne par remainder \(f(-a)\) hota hai.
3. \(a\) nikalne ka aasan tareeqa: divisor ko zero ke barabar rakh dein. \(x + 1 = 0\) se \(x = -1\). Bas yahi \(a\) hai.

Ab dekhte hain ke yeh qaida sach kyun hai. Maan lijiye hum polynomial \(f(x)\) ko \((x - a)\) se divide karte hain. 9.1 mein humne seekha tha ke Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder. To ek unique (sirf ek hi) quotient \(q(x)\) aur ek unique remainder \(R\) aisa milta hai ke

Ab equation (i) mein \(x = a\) rakhein. Dono taraf \(x\) ki jagah \(a\) aayega:
\[f(a) = (a - a)q(a) + R\]
\[f(a) = R\]
Yani remainder \(= f(a)\). Saabit ho gaya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Proof ki is line mein kitab ne left side par \(f(x)\) chhap diya hai. Jab \(x = a\) rakha to left side bhi \(f(a)\) banega; sahi line \(f(a) = (a - a)q(a) + R\) hai, jaise humne upar likhi. Agli line \(f(a) = R\) kitab mein sahi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Proof ka kamaal sirf ek baat mein hai: \(x = a\) par factor \(x - a\) ban jata hai \(a - a = 0\). Aur zero ko kisi bhi cheez se multiply karein, jawab zero. Is liye poori term \((x - a)q(x)\) gayab ho jati hai, chahe \(q(x)\) kitna hi lamba kyun na ho. Peeche sirf \(R\) bachta hai. Aur \(R\) par \(x\) ka koi asar nahin, kyun ke woh constant hai.
Khud sochiye: agar divisor sirf \(x\) ho (yani \(a = 0\)), to remainder kya hoga? (Jawab: \(f(0)\), yani polynomial ki constant term. Misaal: \(x^{2} + 3x + 7\) ko \(x\) se divide karein to remainder 7.)
Ab kitab ki do misaalein. Pehli mein seedha remainder nikalna hai; doosri mein remainder diya hua hai aur ek unknown \(k\) dhoondna hai.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: Find the remainder when \(f(x) = x^{4} + x^{3} + x^{2} + 1\) is divided by \(x + 1\) without performing division.
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{4} + x^{3} + x^{2} + 1\), divisor \(x + 1\).
To find: remainder, division kiye baghair.
Method: sawal khud keh raha hai "without performing division", yani remainder theorem lagana hai. Plan: divisor ko \(x - a\) ki shakal mein likh kar \(a\) nikalein, phir \(f(a)\) nikalein.

Step 1: \(a\) maloom karein
\[x - a = x + 1\]
\[\Rightarrow a = -1\]
Kyun: \(x + 1 = x - (-1)\). Doosre lafzon mein, \(x + 1 = 0\) rakhein to \(x = -1\). Yahan sab se aam ghalti \(a = 1\) le lena hai; plus ka sign dekh kar \(a\) hamesha minus wala hota hai.

Step 2: \(f(-1)\) nikalein
\[\text{Remainder} = f(-1)\]
\[= (-1)^{4} + (-1)^{3} + (-1)^{2} + 1\]
\[= 1 + (-1) + 1 + 1 = 2\]
Kyun: remainder theorem ki wajah se. \(-1\) ki even power (2, 4, ...) hamesha \(1\) hoti hai aur odd power (1, 3, ...) hamesha \(-1\). Yeh chhota sa qaida yaad rakhein to aise sawal zubani ho jate hain.

Tasdeeq:
Long division se quotient \(x^{3} + x - 1\) aata hai, aur
\[(x + 1)(x^{3} + x - 1)\]
\[= x^{4} + x^{3} + x^{2} - 1\]
Is mein remainder 2 jama karein to \(x^{4} + x^{3} + x^{2} + 1 = f(x)\). Jawab bilkul sahi; aur dekhiye, theorem ne yeh sab mehnat bacha di.

blocks.title: Example 4
blocks.problem: Find the value of \(k\) if the polynomial \(x^{3} + kx^{2} - 7x + 6\) has a remainder \(-4\), when divided by \(x + 2\).
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{3} + kx^{2} - 7x + 6\), divisor \(x + 2\), remainder \(-4\).
To find: \(k\) ki value.
Method: sab se pehle socho ke remainder kis cheez ke barabar hai: remainder theorem ke mutabiq \(f(-2)\) ke. \(f(-2)\) mein \(k\) aayega. Ise diye hue remainder \(-4\) ke barabar rakhenge to \(k\) ki ek simple equation ban jayegi.

Step 1: \(a\) maloom karein
\[x - a = x + 2\]
\[\Rightarrow a = -2\]
Kyun: \(x + 2 = x - (-2)\), yani \(x + 2 = 0\) se \(x = -2\).

Step 2: Remainder ko \(k\) ki shakal mein likhein
\[\text{Remainder} = f(-2)\]
\[= (-2)^{3} + k(-2)^{2} - 7(-2) + 6\]
\[= -8 + 4k + 14 + 6\]
\[= 4k + 12\]
Kyun: \((-2)^{3} = -8\) (odd power, sign minus), \((-2)^{2} = 4\) (even power, sign plus) aur \(-7 \times (-2) = +14\). Negative number rakhte waqt hamesha bracket lagayein, warna sign gum ho jata hai.

Step 3: Diya hua remainder istemal karein
\[4k + 12 = -4\]
\[\Rightarrow 4k = -16\]
\[\Rightarrow k = -4\]
Kyun: sawal mein remainder \(-4\) diya hai, is liye \(f(-2) = -4\). Dono taraf se 12 ghatayein, phir 4 se divide karein.

Tasdeeq:
\(k = -4\) rakhne se \(f(x) = x^{3} - 4x^{2} - 7x + 6\), aur
\[f(-2) = -8 - 16 + 14 + 6 = -4\]
Bilkul diya hua remainder. Jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 4 ke hal mein kitab ne "Remainder" ki jagah "Remember" chhap diya hai. Sahi line yeh hai: Remainder \(= f(-2)\) (remainder theorem se). Yeh sirf spelling ki ghalti hai; hisaab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Scan mein kitab ki kuch minus ki lakeerein bohat halki hain (jaise \(-8 + 4k\) mein \(-8\) aur aakhir mein \(k = -4\)). Agar aap ko kitab mein "8" ya "4" nazar aaye to ghabraiye mat: hisaab ke mutabiq yeh \(-8\) aur \(-4\) hi hain, jaise upar tasdeeq se saabit hua.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. \(2x^{3} - 3x^{2} + 4\) ko \(x - 2\) se divide karne par remainder kya hoga?
Hal: \(a = 2\), to remainder \(= f(2) = 2(8) - 3(4) + 4 = 16 - 12 + 4 = 8\).
Ab khud koshish karein: isi polynomial ko \(x + 1\) se divide karne par remainder? (Jawab: \(f(-1) = -2 - 3 + 4 = -1\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Remainder theorem: \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se divide karein to remainder \(f(a)\) hota hai.
2. \(a\) woh value hai jis par divisor zero ho jaye: \(x + 2\) ke liye \(a = -2\).
3. Yeh theorem sirf remainder deta hai, quotient nahin. Quotient chahiye to division (ya synthetic division, 9.1.3) karni paregi.
4. Agar remainder diya ho aur polynomial mein unknown ho, to \(f(a) =\) diya hua remainder likh kar equation hal karein.
5. Proof ki jaan: \(x = a\) par \((x - a)q(x)\) zero ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(a\) ka sign ulta le lena: \(x + 1\) ke liye \(f(-1)\) nikalna hai, \(f(1)\) nahin.
2. Negative numbers ki powers mein sign ki ghalti: \((-2)^{3} = -8\) lekin \((-2)^{2} = +4\).
3. Value rakhte waqt bracket na lagana: \(k(-2)^{2}\) likhein, \(k - 2^{2}\) nahin; warna \(4k\) ki jagah ghalat jawab aata hai.
4. Remainder theorem ko quadratic divisor (jaise \(x^{2} - x + 1\)) par lagane ki koshish; yeh sirf \(x - a\) ke liye hai.
